title: Abraham's Call
description: God calls Abram to leave his country, his people and his father's household and go to Canaan. He promises to make him into a great nation and to bless all the families of the earth through him. Abram obeys, leaving Harran with Sarai and Lot, and builds altars to the Lord in the promised land.
